## Summary

Describe the smallest intended change and why it is needed.

## Security and Privacy

- [ ] No reusable credentials or private data were added.
- [ ] Read/write/execute boundaries remain explicit.
- [ ] New privileged behavior is separately authorized or remains disabled.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=high`
- [ ] `npm run smoke`
- [ ] Documentation matches the verified candidate state.

## Lifecycle

This repository remains Development unless separate release, deployment, production-acceptance, and lifecycle evidence establishes otherwise.
